name: Neem Coated Urea
primary_target: Nitrogen deficiency, vegetative vigor, chlorophyll synthesis
application_mode: Split top dressing before irrigation or light rain
precautions: Avoid application in standing deep water or right before heavy storms

name: Di-Ammonium Phosphate (DAP)
primary_target: Phosphorus deficiency, early root establishment, vigorous tillering
application_mode: Basal application at sowing via seed-cum-fertilizer drill
precautions: Place 2-3 cm below seed to avoid seed burn

name: Muriate of Potash (MOP)
primary_target: Potassium deficiency, drought resistance, grain weight, lodging prevention
application_mode: Basal application or split at boot leaf stage
precautions: Crucial for lodging-prone high yielding dwarf varieties

name: Zinc Sulfate Heptahydrate (21% Zn + 10% S)
primary_target: Khaira disease in rice, interveinal chlorosis in wheat, enzyme activation
application_mode: Soil application @ 10 kg/acre or foliar spray 0.5% with 0.25% lime
precautions: Never mix directly with DAP or phosphate fertilizers (causes insoluble zinc phosphate precipitation)

name: NPK Complex (12:32:16)
primary_target: Balanced starter nutrition for cereal crops
application_mode: Basal placement along with seed sowing
precautions: Ideal balanced substitute for DAP + MOP blend
